description.value:
When you cast the Hunter's Mark spell or transfer its effect to a new target, you can transform the spell into a Sanctified Mark as part of the same Bonus Action. The effect persists while this casting of Hunter's Mark is active, including when you select a new target. Sanctified Mark retains all the usual effects of Hunter's Mark in addition to the following:

  • The target of this effect cannot benefit from Invisibility against you. And the range of any Locate X spell you cast to track the creature is doubled.
  • When you hit the target with a weapon attack, you can choose to change the damage type of your weapon and Sanctified Mark to radiant or necrotic.
  • The spell does not count towards your Concentration limit, though you still have to roll Concentration Saving Throws as normal. If you fail a Concentration Saving Throws, you lose Concentration on all spells you are concentrating on.
